<?php
class SetBase190 { private $hidden = 1; private const VALUE = 10; public function __set(string $name, $incoming): void { global $owner, $held, $input; $owner = null; $input = 9; $held = new class($name, $incoming, self::VALUE, static::VALUE, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public string $name, public int $value, public int $lexical, public int $called, public string $method) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; echo 'SET;'; } public function __destruct() { global $input; $input = 11; echo 'OWNER;'; } }
class SetCalled190 extends SetBase190 { public const VALUE = 20; }
$owner = new SetCalled190; $input = 7; $assigned = ($owner->hidden = $input); echo 'ANSWER;', $assigned, ':', $input, ';', $held->name, ':', $held->value, ':', $held->lexical, ':', $held->called, ':', $held->method, ';'; unset($held); echo 'AFTER;';

<?php
$owner = new class { private $hidden = 1; public function __isset(string $name): bool { global $owner; $owner = null; $child = new class($name, true) { public function __construct(public string $name, public bool $ok) { echo 'CHILD;'; } public function __destruct() { echo 'DROP-CHILD;'; } }; echo 'ISSET;'; return $child->ok; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } };
$name = $owner::class; $answer = isset($owner->hidden); $after = new class {}; echo 'ANSWER;', $answer, ';', $name, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class { private $hidden = 1; public function __unset(string $name): void { global $owner, $held; $owner = null; $held = new class($name, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public string $name, public string $method) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; echo 'UNSET;'; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } };
$name = $owner::class; unset($owner->hidden); $after = new class {}; echo 'HELD;', $held->name, ':', $held->method, ';', $name, ';', $held::class, ';', $after::class, ';'; unset($held); echo 'AFTER;';

<?php
echo 'PRE;';
class BadIsset190 {
 public function __isset(string $name): bool { $child = new class { final private function hidden() {} }; return true; }
 public const int BAD = 'bad';
}
